annotations.title: Show an email check and its results

description: Show one email check: status (checking, completed, expired, pending_approval, cancelled), counts, credited_cents, credits (each store credit with its kind and why) and, once completed, every address as {email, result, reason, suggestion?}. While checking: results_so_far (the sure answers so far, which never change), answered and pending. Poll it after check_emails; list_email_checks finds older ones. Results are deleted 7 days after the check completes (expired: counts only). results false leaves out the results and results_so_far. Unknown id: 404 check_not_found.

check_id.description: Check id (ec_...) from check_emails or list_email_checks.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.

results.description: false: leave the results out (default true).

name: get_email_check
title: Show an email check and its results
